rajkiya-engineering-college-bijnor.description: Rajkiya Engineering College, Bijnor is a Government of Uttar Pradesh engineering college at Chandpur in Bijnor district, affiliated to AKTU.
rajkiya-engineering-college-bijnor.about: The college was started by the Uttar Pradesh Department of Technical Education under the Special Component Plan, with admissions from 2010-11. It was earlier called Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar Engineering College of Information Technology and was renamed in 2015. It began with civil, electrical and IT branches and added computer science and mechanical engineering in 2018-19.
rajkiya-engineering-college-bijnor.address: Jaleelpur Block, Chandpur, Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh 246725
rajkiya-engineering-college-bijnor.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

veer-kunwar-institute-of-technology-bijn.description: Veer Kunwar Institute of Technology is the engineering college of the VKIT Group on the Bijnor-Nagina road.
veer-kunwar-institute-of-technology-bijn.about: VKIT started in 2008 under the Kunwar Kali Education Trust. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. Its campus covers about 20 acres on the Bijnor-Nagina road.
veer-kunwar-institute-of-technology-bijn.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

babu-banarsi-das-institute-of-engineerin.description: Babu Banarsi Das Institute of Engineering Technology and Research Centre is an engineering college on the Bulandshahr-Anoopshahr road at Jahangirabad.
babu-banarsi-das-institute-of-engineerin.about: The institute was established in 1998 under the Akhil Bhartiya Babu Banarsi Das Smarak Sewa Sansthan. It is affiliated to the state technical university at Lucknow (formerly UPTU, now AKTU) and approved by AICTE and the UP Government. The campus is 25 km along the Bulandshahr-Anoopshahr road.
babu-banarsi-das-institute-of-engineerin.address: 25 Km, Bulandshahr-Anoopshahr Road, Jahangirabad, Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh 202394
babu-banarsi-das-institute-of-engineerin.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

marathwada-institute-of-technology-mit.description: Marathwada Institute of Technology, Bulandshahr is an engineering college of the MIT group at Dhamera-Chola in the Sikandarabad area of Bulandshahr.
marathwada-institute-of-technology-mit.about: The Bulandshahr campus was established in 1999. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, with some programmes under Chaudhary Charan Singh University, Meerut. It offers B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, BCA and diploma programmes.
marathwada-institute-of-technology-mit.address: Village Dhamera-Chola, Taluka Sikandarabad, District Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh 203001
marathwada-institute-of-technology-mit.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

bahab-dr-bhim-ram-ambedkar-college-of-ag.description: Baba Saheb Dr. B.R. Ambedkar College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology is a constituent college of CSA University of Agriculture and Technology, Kanpur, located at Etawah.
bahab-dr-bhim-ram-ambedkar-college-of-ag.about: The college was established in 1994 and began its B.Tech in agricultural engineering in 1994-95. It added electronics and communication and computer science in 2002-03 and mechanical engineering in 2003-04. Its campus covers about 147 acres at Etawah.
bahab-dr-bhim-ram-ambedkar-college-of-ag.affiliated_to: Chandra Shekhar Azad University of Agriculture and Technology, Kanpur

accurate-institute-of-management-and-tec.description: Accurate Institute of Management and Technology is a private engineering and management college in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida.
accurate-institute-of-management-and-tec.about: AIMT was set up in 2006. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow, and states that it is NAAC accredited. It offers B.Tech, BCA, MCA, MBA and PGDM programmes.
accurate-institute-of-management-and-tec.address: 49, Knowledge Park-III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306
accurate-institute-of-management-and-tec.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

delhi-technical-campus.description: Delhi Technical Campus is an engineering, architecture and management institute in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, affiliated to Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University.
delhi-technical-campus.about: DTC was established in 2013 by the founders of Mayoor School, Noida, in collaboration with GC Mayo College, Ajmer. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, New Delhi. It offers engineering, architecture and management programmes.
delhi-technical-campus.address: 28/1, Knowledge Park-III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306
delhi-technical-campus.affiliated_to: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, New Delhi

dtc-college.description: Delhi Technical Campus is an engineering, architecture and management institute in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, affiliated to Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University.
dtc-college.about: DTC was established in 2013 by the founders of Mayoor School, Noida, in collaboration with GC Mayo College, Ajmer. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, New Delhi. It offers engineering, architecture and management programmes.
dtc-college.address: 28/1, Knowledge Park-III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306
dtc-college.affiliated_to: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, New Delhi

dronacharya-group-of-institutions.description: Dronacharya Group of Institutions is a private AKTU-affiliated engineering college in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, accredited by NAAC with an A grade.
dronacharya-group-of-institutions.about: DGI was established in 2006 in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. It received a NAAC A grade in 2024-25, after an earlier B++.
dronacharya-group-of-institutions.address: Knowledge Park-III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
dronacharya-group-of-institutions.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

g-l-bajaj-institute-of-technology-and-ma.description: G.L. Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management is an autonomous private engineering college in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, with a NAAC A+ grade.
g-l-bajaj-institute-of-technology-and-ma.about: GLBITM was established in 2005 and is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE. It was the first private engineering college in Uttar Pradesh to earn NAAC A+ in its first cycle. It was also the first private institute in the state to receive UGC autonomous status.
g-l-bajaj-institute-of-technology-and-ma.address: Plot No. 2, Knowledge Park-III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306
g-l-bajaj-institute-of-technology-and-ma.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
